section_map.inference: Choosing the online API as default is a design judgment.
Immutable generations, reclamation interlock, and durable leases are proposed design, not SQLite features.
Bundle format, privacy policy, and gating are proposal choices.
Cross-platform fsync/crash durability must be tested.

unresolved_uncertainty: Exact CPython 3.13.9 build and linked SQLite version are not known; record sys.version and sqlite3.sqlite_version.
Attachment schema/store and cross-process garbage collector were not inspected; immutable generations are a prerequisite.
OS/filesystem matrix is unspecified; interprocess locking, directory durability and crash recovery require platform review.
Performance, memory, save/progress/cancel latency, restore and durability are untested.
The active runtime banner showed gpt-6-luna/max effort; native receipt omitted provider/service tier, so Luna Max Standard tier status is unknown.
